title: Setting the Board in Chaos
next_chapter_hook: When the final formation eye fell into place, Chen Ji suddenly sensed an异样 pulse from the ground beneath his feet—it was not the aura of a dragon vein, but a massive rift spanning time and space, as if something was gazing at him from the depths of that crack.

text.content: The moonlight of the midnight hour was obscured by heavy clouds, and the mountains surrounding the Holy Sect lay in deathly silence. Chen Ji tucked the jade slip into his sleeve, the corner of his lips lifting slightly. Ling Yuan's message had come at the perfect time—the convergence point of dragon veins was precisely the ideal location to布置 the Tianji Formation. He raised his gaze toward the distant Sacred Mountain, where lanterns blazed brightly, and scouts from various factions had surely turned every inch of soil upside down.

He slowly exhaled a breath of turbid air, spiritual power condensing into a tiny rune at his fingertips. This was the 'Mirror Flower Water Moon' Formation recorded in the Tianji Record Fragment—deploying it required forty-nine base runes, each precisely embedded at meridian nodes, allowing not a hair's breadth of error. The Crown Prince's Grand Tutor was currently drinking tea in the camp below the mountain. If he wanted to disrupt this chess game, he must first hide himself well.

dialogue.content: (Taking out the first material) Crown Prince's Grand Tutor, hmph, let him stare at the Tianqing Sect's direction for a few more days.

text.content: Chen Ji retrieved a 'Travel Token' from his storage bag—a fake identity certificate he had purchased at great expense from the black market, stamped with the seal of the Qingyun Pavilion, which had long since been invalidated. He hung the token at his waist, then deliberately rolled up the corner of his sleeve, revealing the Tianqing Sect mark on his inner lining. This step seemed superfluous, but it was the key to his entire plan: keeping the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor's attention firmly fixed on the Tianqing Sect.

He began moving along his pre-surveyed route, burying a base rune at each meridian node he passed. His movements were neither fast nor slow, with a rhythm as plain as an old farmer tilling the field, yet precise as if measured by a ruler. Night wind swept through the treetops, carrying the sounds of distant patrol teams. Chen Ji didn't even lift his eyelids, as if those sounds simply did not exist.

dialogue.content: (Via spiritual sense transmission) Chen Ji, Elder Zhou inside the Holy Sect has agreed. He wants three spirit mushrooms aged a hundred years, plus that thing you promised.

text.content: Chen Ji's steps never stopped, but his hand paused for a moment. Su Qingyao's spiritual sense transmission came through clearly, carrying a trace of barely perceptible worry. He did not reply immediately; instead, he steadily embedded the thirty-seventh rune into the depths of the meridian before silently thinking: I already prepared the hundred-year spirit mushrooms long ago, let her rest assured. Also, tell her not to seek me lately—when things get noisy, no one will be able to leave.

When setting the thirty-ninth rune, Chen Ji suddenly halted. He tilted his head to listen, a playful smile appearing at the corner of his lips. A thousand meters away, an elusive spiritual sense was sweeping across this area—that was the distinctive probing technique of the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor's chief strategist, meticulous, greedy, and full of the desire to control. Very well, the fish has taken the bait.

choice.prompt: The Crown Prince's Grand Tutor's scout was about to lock onto this area, and Chen Ji had to make a decision:

choices.text: Deliberately expose the Tianqing Sect disciple identity
choices.description: Turn the tables on the plan, performing a scene of 'discovering the forbidden grounds and fleeing in panic' before the scout, completely pinning the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor's attention on the Tianqing Sect.
choices.visible_reward: The Crown Prince's Grand Tutor will believe the Tianqing Sect is conducting a secret operation
choices.risk_hint: If the acting is exposed, the whereabouts will be directly revealed

text.content: Chen Ji's lips lifted slightly, and he flicked his fingers. A yellowed concealment talisman burned silently in the night. He deliberately let the Tianqing Sect's aura flash before the scout, then instantly fled in the opposite direction like a startled rabbit. The movements were狼狈 yet cleverly concealed—the spiritual residue he left behind pointed precisely toward the Tianqing Sect's secret outpost on the outskirts of the Holy Sect.

dialogue.content: (Cold smile in heart) Go on, bring this news to your master. Tell him that废物 Chen Ji infiltrated the forbidden grounds at night and fled in panic.

choices.text: Activate the Tianji Record to conceal aura
choices.description: Consume 5 points of Heavenly Fate, using the power of the Tianji Record Fragment to completely seal one's own aura, leaving the scout discovering nothing. Safe but will weaken the Heavenly Fate reserve for subsequent actions.
choices.visible_reward: Aura completely disappears, scout will find nothing
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate is a lifesaver card, consumption here will affect subsequent variables

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, and the Tianji Record Fragment slowly unfurled in his mental sea. A晦涩 force surged from his elixir field, enveloping him in a layer of mist-like presence. When the scout's spiritual sense swept by, it would only feel that area was empty, even the meridian fluctuations twisted into traces of natural dissipation.

dialogue.content: (Feeling the Heavenly Fate value drain with pain) Five points... That old fox Ling Yuan is probably waiting to see me waste my Heavenly Fate on such matters.

text.content: Only after that spiritual sense departed did Chen Ji slowly open his eyes. The work of setting the remaining ten runes was completed smoothly before dawn, and the Mirror Flower Water Moon Formation finally took shape. He stood at the center of the formation's eye, looking around—from this angle, the entire spiritual meridian layout of the Holy Sect's outskirts was visible, as clear as the latitude and longitude lines on a chessboard.

Now only the final step remained: to create resonance between Chen Nian's position and this formation. She carried Chen bloodline, and after being captured by the Holy Sect and transformed into a 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key,' she was essentially another manifestation of Chen bloodline. As long as the timing was right to activate the formation, the bloodline imprint within her would resonate, thereby revealing her exact imprisonment location.

dialogue.content: (Murmuring softly) Little Nian, wait a bit longer, brother will find you soon.

choice.prompt: The formation was complete, but there were still three hours until the midnight dragon vein convergence. Chen Ji needed to decide the next move:

choices.text: Use this time to scout Holy Sect defenses
choices.description: Taking advantage of the chaos on the Holy Sect's outskirts, approach the Holy Sect Mountain Gate in the guise of a wandering cultivator, survey the outer patrol patterns and defensive weak points, preparing for the subsequent rescue.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain detailed intelligence on Holy Sect defensive deployment
choices.risk_hint: Holy Sect disciples are everywhere on the outskirts, a single careless move will startle the snake

text.content: Chen Ji straightened his clothes, suppressed his cultivation to Foundation Building initial stage, put on a pleasant yet mediocre face, and swaggered toward the market on the Holy Sect's outskirts. With all factions gathered here and the number of wandering cultivators surging, his 'newly arrived' appearance drew no attention whatsoever. Over several hours, he had clearly mapped out the patrol schedules of the Holy Sect's three defensive lines.

dialogue.content: (Drawing the defensive layout in his mind) The eastern defense line has the slowest rotation, with roughly a quarter-hour gap around midnight... That's enough.

choices.text: Proactively contact Ye Qing to confirm cooperation details
choices.description: The Holy Sect's Saint of the Demonic Path possesses the ability to conceal Tianji Record aura, making her a key ally in the Chen Nian rescue plan. Chen Ji needed to finalize a few details with her.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain demonic path mist concealment, ensuring the Tianji Formation activation goes undetected by the Heavenly Eye
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing is unfathomable, cooperation is stable but will inevitably leave hidden dangers

text.content: Chen Ji found a secluded corner and activated a communication jade talisman using the special technique from the Tianji Record Fragment. After a moment, a cold spiritual consciousness transmitted: 'You certainly know how to pick your timing to find me.' Ye Qing's voice carried a trace of exhaustion, yet also hidden anticipation. Though trapped within the Holy Sect's Inner Sect, she seemed to have long anticipated Chen Ji would contact her at this critical moment.

dialogue.content: (Via spiritual sense transmission) The moment the formation activates, the Heavenly Eye will certainly sense it. I will create a disturbance inside the Holy Sect beforehand, buying you three breaths of time—three breaths, is that enough?

text.content: Just as Chen Ji was preparing to continue, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly vibrated violently. His expression changed slightly, and he quickly probed with his spiritual sense—within was a fluctuation he had never felt before, as if something extremely ancient and extremely dangerous was awakening from slumber. It was not coming from the Holy Sect, but from... beneath his feet.

Chen Ji spun around, his gaze penetrating layers of rock and soil to the depths below. There, a temporal-spatial rift spanning an unknowable number of ten thousand miles was slowly tearing open, its scale far surpassing anything he had ever witnessed. Even the Tianji Record Fragment let out a sharp mournful cry at this moment, as if warning its master: this is not a domain you should touch.

dialogue.content: (Pupils contracting sharply) This... is this the dragon vein convergence Ling Yuan mentioned? No, this is by no means a dragon vein—this leads to...

text.content: Before the words finished, a vast tide of consciousness surged forth from the depths of the rift. Chen Ji felt his mind explode with a roar, countless fragmented images flashing like a carousel—the perspective of the Heavenly Eye, gazing through this rift at this land about to fall into chaos. And that consciousness seemed to also notice his probing, like a slumbering giant slowly opening its eyes.

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye's consciousness was approaching Chen Ji, and he had to make an immediate choice:

choices.text: Forcefully sever the connection and retreat into the formation's shelter
choices.description: Immediately activate the Mirror Flower Water Moon Formation, using the formation's camouflage power to shield himself and vanish from the Heavenly Eye's scan. This was Chen Ji's most skilled escape method.
choices.visible_cost: Consume formation energy, increased risk of exposing the feigned death plan
choices.visible_reward: Safely disengage from the Heavenly Eye's lock
choices.risk_hint: Once the formation is used, it will no longer be complete, affecting subsequent plans

text.content: Chen Ji made his decision instantly, his fingers tapping multiple formation eyes in succession. The Mirror Flower Water Moon Formation roared to life. Layers upon layers of illusions wove a net within a hundred-zhang radius, enveloping him entirely. When the Heavenly Eye's consciousness swept across this area, it would only feel the place was empty and worthless, then turn to search elsewhere. The cost was that the formation had already been exposed before it once.

dialogue.content: (Cold sweat dripping) That was close... So the old thing really has been watching all along. That old fox Ling Yuan probably knew there would be such disturbance here long ago—what exactly is his purpose in sending me that message?

choices.text: Risk peering into the depths of the rift
choices.description: Using the Tianji Record Fragment as a medium, endure the risk of backlash to peer into the secrets of the rift's depths. May gain key intelligence in a desperate situation, even discover a turning point to reverse fate.
choices.visible_cost: Endure severe backlash, may sustain serious injury
choices.visible_reward: Peer into the core secrets of the Heavenly Eye, obtain unprecedented intelligence
choices.risk_hint: Degree of backlash unknown, may lose consciousness on the spot

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth and forcefully pierced through the rift's barrier with his spiritual sense. In that instant, excruciating pain drowned him like a tide—the Tianji Record Fragment vibrated frantically, scorching energy spread from his mental sea throughout his body, every spirit aperture screaming. But just as consciousness was about to scatter, he saw the scene within the rift's depths: an endless void, and within that void, densely packed threads intertwined into a web, each thread's end connected to a point of light.

dialogue.content: (Struggling not to fall) Those points of light... they are the prophets of past eras. The Tianji Record is merely its marionette, and am I... also one of them?

text.content: When Chen Ji opened his eyes again, the sky was already brightening with the first light of dawn. He did not know how long he had been unconscious, only that his entire body felt as empty and weak as if hollowed out. And that temporal-spatial rift had now completely sealed shut, as if it had never existed. But he knew it was not an illusion—the terror of the Heavenly Eye was, for the first time, so clearly branded upon the bottom of his heart.

Midnight approached, and Ling Yuan's message arrived like a silent催促. Chen Ji took a deep breath and walked with heavy steps toward the dragon vein convergence point. His plan remained intact, his chess pieces still in position—only now, he had one more truth he had to face: in this chess game, he had never been the chess player, but a piece being gradually driven into a corner. But so what? What Chen Ji excelled at most was slashing a bloodied path through the most desperate of circumstances.
